import hashlib,json,subprocess,re,sys,os,time,signal
from pathlib import Path
out=Path('core/docs/issues/307/checks/r2-completion-future-20261008')
pins=json.loads((out/'02-source-identity.json').read_text())
assert all(hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for p,h in pins.items()), 'source mismatch'
base=['--manifest-path','core/Cargo.toml','--locked','-p','layerfs-daemon','--all-targets']
start=time.monotonic_ns()
build=subprocess.run(['cargo','test',*base,'--no-run'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=300)

if build.returncode:sys.exit(build.returncode)
results=[]
for name in ['completion_future','completion_ownership','completion_storage','owner']:
    binary=re.search(r'Executable tests/'+name+r'\.rs \(([^)]+)\)',build.stdout)[1]
    cmd=[binary,'--test-threads=1','--nocapture']
    start=time.monotonic_ns()
    with (out/('linux-'+name+'.txt')).open('x') as output:
        child=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=output,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
        timeout=False
        try:code=child.wait(timeout=100)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            timeout=True;os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGKILL);code=child.wait()
    result={'command':cmd,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(binary).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'exit_code':code,'timeout':timeout,'wall_ns':time.monotonic_ns()-start,'wall_stop_seconds':100}
    results.append(result);print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)
    print((out/('linux-'+name+'.txt')).read_text()[-1300:],flush=True)
    if code:break
(out/'12-linux-test-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
if any(r['exit_code'] for r in results):sys.exit(1)
clippy=subprocess.run(['cargo','clippy',*base,'--','-D','warnings'],timeout=300)
